name: Mermaid
description: Renders Mermaid diagrams to PNG and sends them to the conversation.

saveDir.label: Diagrams folder
saveDir.help: Where each .mmd and .png is kept. Absolute, or relative to the agent workspace.

source.label: Send the source
source.help: onRequest: a .txt only when asked. always: a .txt with every diagram.

textPosition.label: Text position
textPosition.help: after: the image, then the text. before: the text, then the image.

saveDir.description: Where each .mmd and .png is kept. Absolute, or relative to the agent workspace. Created if missing. Unset: out/diagrams in the agent workspace.

timeoutMs.description: Longest a render may run before it is stopped, in milliseconds.

maxSourceChars.description: Longest Mermaid source render_mermaid accepts, in characters.

source.description: When the Mermaid source goes out as a .txt file after the image: only when the agent is asked for it, or with every diagram.

textPosition.description: Whether the agent's text comes after the image or before it.
